findings.finding: A 401 from validating an expired access token must not immediately require a new OAuth consent if the saved Authorization Code refresh token can still recover it.
findings.resolution: Spec revised: attempt Twurple's documented saved-token refresh; require consent only on definitive refresh authorization failure or unrecoverable identity/scope mismatch.

findings.finding: The server awaits createApplicationRuntime before app.listen, and Twitch initialization currently waits for remote validation. This can keep the local panel unavailable when Twitch is down at process startup.
findings.resolution: Spec revised to require non-blocking Twitch supervision after local runtime creation; saved Twitch initialization is background work while local API/DB remain available.

findings.finding: Existing Twurple session_reconnect is a seamless subscription migration and must not be treated as a dropped-event interval or trigger a parallel socket.
findings.resolution: Spec now distinguishes native session migration from actual socket loss; reconcile only after actual disconnect and fresh ready.

findings.finding: Initial EventSub connection retries have a finite retry limit in the installed Twurple dependency; an integration can otherwise remain stuck after startup failure.
findings.resolution: Spec requires verifying and supervising initial exhaustion without replacing Twurple's own session migration.

findings: All requirements have at least one acceptance and proposed automated test.
FND-4/FND-5 overlap is bounded: OPS-8 extends startup/failure supervision and status, reusing OAuth persistence, outbox and reconciliation.
OAuth error classification preserves the refresh-token recovery path and avoids treating transient errors as revocation.
Startup availability, lifecycle cancellation, duplicate recovery, event overlap and financial intent preservation are explicitly covered.
The exact installed Twurple 8.2.0 reconnect behavior and official Twitch OAuth/EventSub constraints are documented with sources.

implementationGate: Planning complete; implementation may begin with test-first increments. Stage promotion remains prohibited until OPS-8, FND-9, and DOC-2 are complete.
